TVK MLA V.S. Babu, who defeated M.K. Stalin in Kolathur, passes away
 Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam MLA V.S. Babu had been admitted to MGM Healthcare in Aminjikarai, Chennai, with a prolonged respiratory illness
 Updated - November 19, 2026 03:46 pm IST - CHENNAI 
 The Hindu Bureau READ LATER 
 SEE ALL 
 Remove 
 V.S. Babu. File
 | Photo Credit: R. Ragu
 Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) MLA V.S. Babu, who defeated DMK president and former Chief Minister M.K. Stalin in the Kolathur Assembly constituency in the 2026 Tamil Nadu Assembly election, died following a cardiac arrest on Thursday (November 19, 2026). He was 75.
 Mr. Babu was admitted to MGM Hospital in Aminjikarai, Chennai, on September 9 with a respiratory illness. According to the medical bulletin issued by the hospital, he was under intensive care. His condition continued to deteriorate, and he subsequently suffered a cardiac arrest and died on November 19 at 2.24 p.m.
 Mr. Babu started his political career in the DMK as an area secretary and went on to become the party’s north Chennai district secretary.
 He was first elected to the Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly from the Purasawalkam Assembly constituency in the 2006 Assembly election as a DMK candidate. Following the 2008 delimitation exercise, the Purasawalkam constituency ceased to exist, and many areas falling under it became part of the newly formed Kolathur Assembly constituency.
 Mr. Babu, then a local face of the DMK, reportedly played a considerable role in Mr. Stalin’s victory in the Kolathur Assembly constituency in the 2011 election. After 2011, Mr. Babu stayed away from politics for a while before joining the AIADMK in 2016. Earlier this year, he joined the TVK in the presence of party president and now Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay.
 With his passing, the number of vacancies in the Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly has risen to six.
 Governor expresses condolences
 Tamil Nadu Governor Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar condoled the death of Mr. Babu. In a post on X, Lok Bhavan, Tamil Nadu, said the Governor remembers the departed leader’s public life and service and prays to the almighty to grant strength and courage to the bereaved family to bear this irreparable loss.
